tokens.iast: athocyate liṅgapūjā sūcitā mālinīmate // 1b eteṣāmūrdhvaśāstroktamantrāṇāṃ na pratiṣṭhitam / bahiṣkuryāttato hyete rahasyatvena siddhidāḥ svavīryānandamāhātmyapraveśavaśaśālinīm / ye siddhiṃ dadate teṣāṃ bāhyatvaṃ rūpavicyutiḥ kiṃca coktaṃ samāveśapūrṇo bhoktrātmakaḥ śivaḥ / bhogalāmpaṭyabhāgbhogavicchede nigrahātmakaḥ śāntatvanyakkriyodbhūtajighatsāvṛṃhitaṃ vapuḥ / svayaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yena so@syābhoge vinaśyati uktaṃ jñānottarāyāṃ ca tadetatparameśinā / śivo yāgapriyo yasmādviśeṣānmātṛmadhyagaḥ tasmādrahasyaśāstreṣu ye mantrāstānbudho bahiḥ / na pratiṣṭhāpayejjātu viśeṣādvyaktarūpiṇaḥ ata eva mṛtasyārthe pratiṣṭhānyatra yoditā / sātra śāstreṣu no kāryā kāryā sādhāraṇī punaḥ ā tanmayatvasaṃsiddherā cābhīṣṭaphalodayāt / putrakaḥ sādhako vyaktamavyaktaṃ vā samāśrayet putrakairgururabhyarthyaḥ sādhakastu svayaṃ vidan / yadi tatsthāpayenno cettenāpyarthyo gururbhavet

tokens.iast: guruścātra nirodhākhye kāla itthaṃ vibhau vadet / jīvatyasminphalāntaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭherjīvāvadhīti vā liṅgaṃ ca bāṇaliṅgaṃ vā ratnajaṃ vātha mauktikam / pauṣpamānnamatho vāstraṃ gandhadravyakṛtaṃ ca vā natu pāṣāṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ śilpyutthaṃ parikalpayet / dhātūtthaṃ ca suvarṇotthavarjamanyadvivarjayet na cātra liṅgamānādi kvacidapyupayujyate / udāravīryairmantrairyadbhāsitaṃ phaladaṃ hi tat tasyāpi sthaṇḍilādyuktavidhinā śuddhimācaret / mantrārpaṇaṃ tathaiva syānnirodhastūktayuktitaḥ agnau ca tarpaṇaṃ bhūriviśeṣāddakṣiṇā guroḥ / dīnāditṛptirvibhavādyāga ityadhiko vidhiḥ sarveṣvavyaktaliṅgeṣu pradhānaṃ syādakalpitam / tathā ca tatra tatroktaṃ lakṣaṇe pārameśvare sūtre pātre dhvaje vastre svayambhūbāṇapūjite / nadīprasravaṇotthe ca nāhvānaṃ nāpi kalpanā pīṭhaprasādamantrāṃśavelādiniyamo naca / vyaktaṃ vā citrapustādau devadārusuvarṇajam atha dīkṣitasacchilpikṛtaṃ sthāpayate guruḥ / athavā lakṣaṇopetamūrdhatatkarparāśritam

tokens.iast: paṅkticakrakaśūlābjavidhinā tūramāśrayet / tallakṣaṇaṃ bruve śrīmatpicuśāstre nirūpitam tūre yogaḥ sadā śastaḥ siddhido doṣavarjite / jālakairjarjarai randhrairdantairūnādhikai rujā yukte ca tūre hāniḥ syāt taddhīne yāga uttamaḥ / kāmya eva bhavettūramiti kecitprapedire guravastu vidhau kāmye yatnāddoṣāṃstyajediti / vyācakṣate picuproktaṃ na nitye karmaṇītyadaḥ śrīsiddhātantra uktaṃ ca tūralakṣaṇamuttamam / ekādikacatuṣkhaṇḍe gomukhe pūrṇacandrake padmagorocanāmuktānīrasphaṭikasaṃnibhe / ekādipañcasadrandhravidyārekhānvite śubhe na rūkṣavakraśakaladīrghanimnasabinduke / ślakṣṇayā vajrasūcyātra sphuṭaṃ devīgaṇānvitam sarvaṃ samālikhetpūjyaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram / etadevānusartavyamarghapātre@pi lakṣaṇam śrībrahmayāmale@pyuktaṃ pātraṃ gomukhamuttamam / gajakūrmatalaṃ kumbhavṛttaśaktikajākṛti akṣasūtramatho kuryāttatraivābhyarcayetkramam / vīradhātujalodbhūtamuktāratnasuvarṇajam
